name: context-docs
description: Maintain project decisions, current work and next steps in Markdown.

interface.longDescription: For coding projects: adopt a Markdown context workflow, then maintain decisions, current work, blockers and next steps. Uses existing project documents and preserves their layouts. This experimental candidate bundles context-docs 0.2.5 and adopt-context-docs 0.1.14. It requires access to the selected project workspace; general chat and hosted environments are unvalidated. Optional local journal helpers require Python 3.9+ and use Git for applicable storage checks. No hosted service or automatic background activity is provided.
